title: Review of c27's Frey-condensate no-division probe: replicates on fresh seed 4; chi=-2 gives 116 and 75 splits with 138 and 76 merges but 0 persistent splits, ending in curved travelling stripes
summary: labkit runs of the chi=-2 arms (M=30, D=0.1, dt=0.002, mean -0.3 and -0.4) on fresh seed 4, 128^2, t=200. Mean -0.3: 116 splits, 138 merges, 0 persistent, final 9 components; mean -0.4: 75 splits, 76 merges, 0 persistent, final 4. Swimming rods up to 4.0-4.1 body lengths; the sheet shows droplets from noise elongating into curved rods, a rotating target pattern at t~100-130 and parallel travelling stripes by t=200, as reported. Supported; chi=-3 and the doubled-kinetics arm not re-run.

observations.finding: rerun/chi2 (seed 4): splits 116, merges 138, persistent splits 0; rerun/chi2_m04: 75/76, 0 persistent; sheet: rods merge into travelling stripes

seeds_run.result: pass: 0 persistent splits in both chi=-2 arms

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, t=200, 128^2; parameters taken from the summary (M=30, D=0.1, dt=0.002); a negative in 2D at these parameters only.
